verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single-command project scaffold and says apps can be deployed to Mastra Cloud or through built-in Vercel/Netlify/Cloudflare deployers. None of it documents an official CLI that authenticates, builds or stages a server, pushes it, and installs it into agents. Scaffolding commands and deployers that are not tied to a CLI are adjacent features, not this publish-and-deploy CLI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
